newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt undecided on attending U.S. summit.
newsitem.headline: Egypt undecided on attending U.S. summit.

text.p: Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak, after days of trying to arrange his own Middle East summit in Cairo, has not decided whether to attend an alternative summit in Washington, officials said on Sunday.
U.S. President Bill Clinton, announcing a summit in Washington on Tuesday, said he had invited Mubarak but the Egyptian leader was still consulting his schedule.
"We are waiting for a decision," said an Egyptian presidential aide, who asked not to be named.
Another official, asked if Mubarak would go, said: "I think you should ask this question tomorrow."

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, Palestinian President Yasser Arafat and King Hussein of Jordan will attend the Washington summit, called to revive Middle East peace talks after days of violence between Israelis and Palestinians.
